repoDescription: Total Recall brain — Node ESM, no TypeScript, no ESLint. Quality here means: dist stays in sync with src, the open-source path invariant holds, and the SSSS reference kernel still passes its own suites.

checks.description: Published dist must not lag src — prepublishOnly depends on this.
INVARIANT: TR core must never hardcode a personal home path or name a third-party product repo. Multi-repo support is path-only (register/track/--repo/TR_SYNC_REPOS/cwd).

patterns.message: Hardcoded absolute home path. Derive from os.homedir(), cwd, or config.
Hardcoded ~/Github path. Use project-registry / TR_SYNC_REPOS / --repo / cwd.
Names a third-party product repo. TR is open-source: host apps are equal implementations, never special-cased.

checks.description: INVARIANT: everything listed in package.json:files goes out in the npm tarball, so the whole shipped surface is subject to the open-source path rule -- not just core JS. open-source-paths scans only .mjs/.js/.cjs and ignores docs/ and scaffold/, which is how a synced skills-registry shipped 562 lines of /Users/<name>/... naming 16 third-party repos, ARCHITECTURE.md shipped file:///Users/... links, and two brand comments named a third-party product repo.

patterns.message: Shipped package contains an absolute home path. Use a generic placeholder (<home>) — this goes out in the npm tarball.
Shipped package contains a personal ~/Github path.
Shipped package names a third-party product repo.

checks.description: INVARIANT: the shipped scaffold must carry no per-brain state, and the brain-state manifest travelling with sync-repo must match the canonical one. Three releases running, a state file was treated as a template and either published or used to overwrite a real brain's data.
Composed SSSS registry must match the committed lock. The old command omitted --lock, so it exited 1 on a usage error and never verified anything.

Full vitest suite — REMOTE ONLY. Running it locally violates the never-run-heavy-node-processes-on-the-laptop invariant; the v2 daemon incident pinned this 8GB machine at load 644. Run on the Mac Mini.
checks.remoteHint: ssh mac-mini 'cd ~/Github/total-recall && export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH && npx vitest run'
